criteria.text: tj-mshi.2 is closed only after COMMERCIAL_CAPABILITIES contains exactly the 22 ratified promises and 3 redirects with their ratified modes, conditions, and sources; direct and not_offered are valid modes; focused tests prove the set; behavior remains unchanged.

tj-mshi.3 is closed only after every registry instruction and its rendered header state a positive permission with its unchanged condition, no registry instruction contains the forbidden negative forms named by the plan, and focused tests prove the contract.

tj-mshi.4 is closed only after every prompt prohibition subsumed by the registry is removed without a compensating prohibition; test_llm_grounding_output.py stays untouched and green; the one named prompt-presence test is replaced by registry coverage and recorded as a declared removal; the recruitment redirect is read by the root and tj-riim closes only if it holds.

tj-mshi.5 is closed only after the frozen twenty openings at seed 20260810 are generated with exactly 20 authorized Luna calls, read blind by the root without --second-reader, compared with the 2026-08-11 baseline, and report criticals, dialog 28, rules 14 and 15, coverage, language, cost, and any finding that the list is too tight.

Each child .2 through .5 has one local main commit and one validated tracked artifact; the required Ruff, format, Mypy, full Pytest, and process gates pass per child; the 31 protected raw outputs replay unchanged through .4; corpus text stays outside Git.

The stage closes only after check_stage_ready.py and run_stage_closeout.py pass at slice_acceptance, the stage summary and Beads truth match accepted work, .codex/handoff.md remains at or below 200 lines and is re-pinned, and no deterministic commitment check, customer-text repair path, push, PR, deploy, live mutation, model configuration change, or real-user message occurs.
